## US Signals Indefinite Iran Blockade Capability; Equity Futures Trade Mixed

Prolonged Middle East tension via an indefinite Iran blockade raises oil-price and risk-premium tail risk; mixed futures suggest incomplete risk repricing, leaving an asymmetric downside for tech names sensitive to energy costs or broader risk-off moves.

- US government indicated it can sustain an Iran blockade indefinitely per the headline.
- Equity futures showed a divergent reaction: Dow Jones futures slipped while S&P 500 gained.
- Geopolitical risk repricing in progress; medium classifier confidence.
- Cross-asset read: split index-future moves suggest the market is not fully pricing a risk-off scenario.
